```quote
Thanks for the update, @PrinceXDev! I don't see the explanation of how this relates to #33086 in the PR description yet. Could you add it, following the [continuing unfinished work guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html)? Please also make the before/after screenshots match one-to-one, as described in the [guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
